positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Senior backend / platform engineer driving Kafka, Kubernetes, and .NET 8 modernization across 35+ services in a high-volume ticketing platform.

- Designed and Architected third-party integrations across multiple systems. 
- Led end-to-end Kafka migration of 35+ backend services with zero production incidents during cutover - defined rollout strategy, topic configurations, ACL workflows, and certificate handling for service teams to adopt consistently.
- Architected modernization of legacy .NET Framework and console applications to .NET 8 on Kubernetes, including scheduled/task-based workload support that retired Windows Task Scheduler dependencies.
- Led AI-assisted engineering adoption with Claude Code — designed custom skills for on-call investigation and Jira-to-merge-request automation and built a Slack support bot surfacing operational data and early root-cause signals.
- Drove security and compliance remediation — least-privilege IAM, secrets cleanup via Vault, vulnerability fixes and mentored engineers on various patterns and secure engineering standards.

Stack: C# • .NET 8 • Kafka (Confluent) • Kubernetes • Docker • AWS (IAM, S3, Lambda, SQS) • Vault • Redis • SQL Server • Grafana • Splunk • GitLab • OpenSearch • Claude Code

projects.title: Entertainment Go - An android application for Entertainment
projects.description:
An android application which enables the users to browse the movies and TV series depending on the ratings given by users and IMDB. Users can also make a wish list of their Movies and titles depending on their preferences. Users can interact with each other by the comment section. A real time movie managing application. 

It is an Entertainment platform related to films, television programs and including cast, production crew, fictional characters, biographies, plot summaries, trivia and reviews. It enables users to sing up and login using facebook in different ways and can be singed up with personal gmail as well. User can even rate movies and TV shows which the users are watching or are present in their wish list. Notification will get popped up as soon as the new Movie or TV series will be added to the application or released. 

Tools: Android Studio, Eclipse 
Build Tools: Gradle Build, Maven build
Technologies: MySQL/No-SQL database, java, android, Facebook integration
Frameworks: Spring Boot, RESTful web services, spring data. 
Analysis: Google Analytics, Facebook Analytics

Future Enhancement: 
Currently working on the other aspect of application. Which is Emotion based Music Player.
Through camera user's emotion will detect and according to emotion Music Player will suggest some good songs playlist. 
Third Party API using:  Microsoft Emotion-API and Spotify API.

projects.title: PayBizSystems
projects.description:
PayBizSystems is a Bill payment System which is independent software system developed to manage the activities like Vendor Registration, Bill Payment from customer to vendor. This system will be the point of which connects both vendor and customer. Using java architecture with JavaFX GUI it is more easy to use by the customer and the vendor.
Main intent of this system is to simplify the billing process between vendor and customer. 

Tools & Technologies : Eclipse, MySQL workbench, Java, JAVAFx, Gluon Scene builder.
